traits.name: Wizard Cantrip
traits.desc: You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace it with another cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

traits.name: Lineage: Detect Magic
traits.desc: Starting at level 3, you always have Detect Magic prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.

traits.name: Lineage: Misty Step
traits.desc: Starting at level 5, you always have Misty Step prepared; you can cast it once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
